enchantment.omnicore.bastion_spikes.desc: Increases Titan Bastion damage reflection by +10% per level and reduces hunger drain.
enchantment.omnicore.aerial_grace.desc: Halves mid-air knockback vulnerability in Zephyr Feather and extends Double Jump distance.
enchantment.omnicore.pyretic_core.desc: Boosts Phoenix Soul healing in lava and reduces water steam damage by 30% per level.
enchantment.omnicore.eagles_eye.desc: Reduces Marksman Focus tunnel vision and extends bullet-time slow motion duration.
enchantment.omnicore.tesla_coil.desc: Doubles Static Conduit charge speed and adds +1 chain lightning target per level.
